name: C&O Canal Trust School and Youth Organization Volunteer Projects

offerings.cycle_label: Group projects along the canal - verified 2026-09-08
offerings.summary: School classes, scout troops and other youth groups spend about three hours on trash and invasive-species removal, painting, mulching, sign washing and pruning along the C&O Canal.

loc.venue: C&O Canal National Historical Park sites

app.instructions: At least one month's advance notice required; response within one week

issues: The programme is booked by a school or youth group rather than by an individual student, and no age rule is published
Entry is through a group leader, not an individual application, which limits solo participation

sources.title: School and Youth Organization Volunteer Opportunities

evidence.cycle: Group projects along the canal - verified 2026-09-08
evidence.quote: trash removal, invasive species removal, painting and scraping, spreading mulch or stone dust, washing signs, lopping and pruning vegetation ... Projects usually run about 3 hours.
